_om: Dobleren in English (Doubler, rusj.no/en/doubler/): 2048, with «Today's blitz» on 3 × 3. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Du klarte det! Vil du se hvor langt du k: You did it! Want to see how far you can go?
Skyv brikkene. To like brikker som møtes: Slide the tiles. When two matching tiles meet, they become one – with double the number. Can you make 2048?
Sveip i en retning, så glir alle brikken: Swipe in one direction and every tile slides as far as it can. The arrow keys and arrow buttons work too.
2 og 2 blir 4, 4 og 4 blir 8 … Hver samm: 2 and 2 make 4, 4 and 4 make 8 … Every merge scores points. After each move a new tile appears.
Er brettet fullt og ingen brikker kan sl: When the board is full and no tiles can merge, the game is over.
Hold den største brikken i et hjørne, og: Keep your biggest tile in a corner and build the numbers up along the edge.
Bruk helst bare tre retninger – da blir: Try to use only three directions – that way your corner is left in peace.
Gjorde du et dumt trekk? Du kan angre de: Made a silly move? You can undo your last move (but not two in a row).
5 × 5 gives you more room and is a bit easier. Each board has its own high score.
Dagens lynrunde er et lite brett på 3 ×: Today's blitz is a little 3 × 3 board with the same tiles for everyone. You get three tries, and the best one counts. No undo here.
Med tastatur: piltastene (eller W, A, S: On a keyboard: the arrow keys (or W, A, S and D) move the tiles, and U undoes.
Piltaster eller WASD flytter · tre forsø: Arrow keys or WASD to move · three tries, the best counts
Piltaster eller WASD flytter · U angrer: Arrow keys or WASD to move · U to undo
Tre forsøk – det beste teller: Three tries – the best one counts
Sveip hvor som helst for å flytte brikke: Swipe anywhere to move the tiles
Hold den største brikken i et hjørne: Keep your biggest tile in a corner
Dagens lynrunde er tatt! Det beste av tr: Today's blitz is in the bag! The best of three tries counts.
Det slo ditt forrige forsøk på {poeng} p: That beat your last try of {poeng} points.
Ny personlig rekord på {brett}! Forrige:: A new personal best on {brett}! Previous: {poeng} points.
Første runde på {brett} – nå har du en r: Your first go on {brett} – now you've got a score to beat!
Brettet og poengene du har nå, forsvinne: Your board and score will be lost.
Klarer du mer på dagens lynrunde?: Can you beat that on today's blitz?
